title: Cod and leek waterzooi
blurb: A gentle Belgian-style fish stew with cod poached in a creamy broth of leeks, carrots and garlic
steps: Trim the leek, slice it in half lengthways, rinse well between the layers, then slice into thin half-moons. Peel the carrots and slice into thin rounds. Peel and finely slice the garlic.
Melt the butter in a wide shallow pan over medium heat. Add the leek, carrots and garlic, then cook gently for about 10 minutes until softened but not browned, stirring occasionally.
Pour in the fish stock and add the bay leaf. Bring to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Check the cod fillet for any bones, then lower it gently into the simmering broth. Cover the pan and poach for 8 to 10 minutes until the fish is just cooked through and flakes easily.
Stir in the crème fraîche and let it warm through without boiling. Remove the bay leaf.
Chop the parsley roughly. Ladle the waterzooi into a wide bowl, season with black pepper and scatter the parsley over the top.
